stem:
Jhanvi tries to hold her breath during a PE warm-up in her school courtyard. After a short time she has to breathe again.

Which statement best explains why holding the breath soon becomes difficult?

options.text: The air she breathes in supplies oxygen that her body needs for its functions, so she cannot go long without a fresh supply.
She needs nitrogen from the air more than anything else, and that is why breath-holding fails quickly.
Her body stops all functions the instant she starts holding her breath.
With enough oxygen stored once, a person can survive indefinitely without food or water as well.

teacher.key_rationale: Breath-holding becomes hard because the body needs ongoing oxygen from breathed air. Substituting nitrogen, treating functions as stopping instantly, or claiming oxygen removes need for food and water are incorrect.
